title: Fluoro Jade stains early and reactive astroglia in the primate cerebral cortex.
abstract: The fluorescent agent Fluoro Jade was applied to cortical brain sections obtained from human patients at early postnatal ages and in patients with Alzheimer's disease, and from a Cebus apella monkey after mechanical lesioning of the cerebral cortex. Fluoro Jade labeled reactive astrocytes and early differentiating astroglial cells.
journal: The journal of histochemistry and cytochemistry : official journal of the Histochemistry Society
